Mexicana, Goddess of the Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean Sea - A fiery and passionate goddess, ruling over the warm and tropical waters of the Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean Sea. She is associated with storms, hurricanes, and the vibrant marine life of the region. She is revered as a protector of sailors and fishermen, but also feared for her unpredictable nature.
